title: ChroSpin - ProteinA
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uvsew6e
materials: Do you want to purify antibodies or sanitize your column? Please choose below.

steps.title: Prepare sample for binding
steps.instruction: Adjust sample to ≤ 500 µl, pH 7.5‑8.5 and 150‑300 mM NaCl (e.g., add 1/11 volume of 0.5 M Tris, 2 M NaCl, pH 8.0). Ensure antibody concentration is 2‑3 mg per sample.

steps.title: Load sample onto column and incubate
steps.instruction: Add the prepared sample to the top of the column. Mix end‑over‑end or invert occasionally for 3 min (30 s for fast‑binding antibodies, up to 10 min for slow‑binding antibodies; longer times increase background).

steps.title: Collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 30‑60 s at 1000 g, place it into a clean receiver tube, and keep the flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE).

steps.title: Wash column with wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl wash buffer, close the lid, invert 5 times, then centrifuge 30‑60 s at 1000 g and discard the receiver tube. Repeat this wash up to 5 times for increased purity; optionally include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl in the wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute bound antibody
steps.instruction: Place the column into a clean receiver tube, add 200 µl elution buffer, close the lid, invert three times, and centrifuge 30‑60 s at 1000 g. Repeat once more to obtain a second 200 µl eluate.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add two drops of neutralization solution to each eluate fraction and mix gently.

steps.title: Post‑purification column wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 500 µl elution buffer, centrifuge 30‑60 s at 1000 g, then wash with 500 µl wash buffer and centrifuge again. If the column was stored previously, first remove the bottom cap, centrifuge 30‑60 s at 1000 g, add 500 µl wash buffer, and centrifuge 30‑60 s at 1000 g before proceeding with the washes above.

steps.title: Sanitize column
steps.instruction: Close the bottom of the column, add 500 µl sanitization solution, close the lid, and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse column with deionized water
steps.instruction: Remove the bottom cap, centrifuge 30‑60 s at 1000 g, then wash three times with 500 µl deionized water, centrifuging 30‑60 s at 1000 g after each wash.

steps.title: Store column for short‑term use
steps.instruction: Close the bottom of the column, add 500 µl PBS containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide, close the lid and store at room temperature or 4‑8 °C. Wait at least 12 hours before the next purification.

steps.title: Long‑term storage (optional)
steps.instruction: Close both top and bottom of the column, then dry the open column in an oven at 80 °C for at least 2 hours or overnight. Ensure the bottom stopper is completely dry, re‑attach the column outlet, close the lid, and store the column closed at room temperature.
